They boast a No. 13 ranking in offensive rating (121.1) and No. 12 ranking in defensive rating (96.5), led by center Robbie Avila, who averages 12.9 points, 4.5 rebounds, and 4.1 assists from the center spot. They have stumbled into the tournament, however, losing their conference finale 86-57 to George Mason and then losing in the A-10 Conference Tournament to Dayton 70-69.Georgia received an at-large bid to get into the tournament, and is one of the most exciting teams in the nation to watch – if you love offense. The Bulldogs average 89.8 points per game, which is No. 5 in the NCAA. They have two key wins on their resume: defeating No. 17 Arkansas 90-76 at home, and on March 3rd, they defeated No. 16 Alabama 98-88.
